comparisons.peer_summary: AMD provides CPUs, APUs, and chipsets for desktops and notebooks with AI capabilities and security features, and uses GPUs with software to power immersive gaming experiences.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose their involvement in the gaming market through specific hardware and services. NVDA explicitly lists its gaming product portfolio as including GeForce RTX/GTX GPUs, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, and SoCs/development services for game consoles. AMD similarly describes its business as using GPUs, semi-custom SoC products, and development services alongside software to power immersive gaming experiences for PCs, game consoles, and cloud gaming services. While NVDA names its specific brand (GeForce) and service (GeForce NOW), AMD describes the functional role of its components (GPUs, semi-custom SoCs) in supporting these same three gaming channels (PC, consoles, cloud).

sentences.text: Our products for the gaming market include GeForce RTX and GeForce GTX GPUs for gaming desktop and laptop PCs, GeForce NOW cloud gaming for playing PC games on underpowered devices, as well as SoCs and development services for game consoles.

Our GPUs, including discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services, work together with software to power immersive gaming experiences for PCs, game consoles and cloud gaming services.
